rules.name: npc_death
rules.description: Any NPC death triggers immediate Author review
rules.condition: An NPC died or was killed during this turn's action outcomes or triggered events.

rules.name: major_ending
rules.description: Player action directly triggers an ending
rules.condition: An event or interaction result contains '##END_' marker, indicating the game is reaching a conclusion.

rules.name: world_rule_violation
rules.description: Player action violates L3 tone constraints or world rules
rules.condition: The player's action or its outcome contradicts the module's tone constraints (genre, forbidden items) or world rules.
